claim: DBT and certain flagship schemes started under NDA
context: Various speeches claiming originality of Direct Benefit Transfer
fact_check_summary: Partially misleading. DBT was launched in January 2013 under UPA. Scale expanded significantly later.
source_type: Fact-check by The Wire and government records

claim: Nehru said ‘I am English by education, Muslim by culture and Hindu by accident of birth’
context: Multiple occasions including TV debates and social media
fact_check_summary: No historical evidence. Historians and archives found no such statement by Nehru.
source_type: Multiple fact-checks including Alt News and The Wire

claim: Massive job creation (e.g., 2 crore jobs per year or far higher than UPA)
fact_check_summary: Contested. Official figures often differ from CMIE and NSSO data showing high unemployment periods and definitional issues (minimal work counted as employed).

claim: Congress manifesto is for Pakistan or prioritises Muslims exclusively
context: 2024 Lok Sabha campaign (Himanta Biswa Sarma and others)
fact_check_summary: Misleading interpretation. Manifesto focused on raising reservation cap for SC/ST/OBC and did not propose religion-based exclusive benefits as claimed.

claim: Congress stopped criticising Adani-Ambani after election notification (implying a deal)
fact_check_summary: False. Congress and Rahul Gandhi continued criticism after the notification.
source_type: Fact-check by The Wire and The Quint

claim: PM Modi is the first head of state to visit Kumbh
fact_check_summary: False. Previous prime ministers and heads of state had visited Kumbh Melas.

claim: Vajpayee was a passenger on India’s first ever metro
context: Speech inaugurating Delhi Metro Magenta line, December 2017
fact_check_summary: False. Kolkata Metro was India’s first (foundation 1972, operations 1984). Delhi Metro was the second.
source_type: Fact-check by The Wire and others

claim: Demonetisation eliminated black money and curbed terrorism
fact_check_summary: Largely contradicted by RBI data showing approximately 99% of demonetised currency returned to the system. Limited evidence of sustained impact on black money or terrorism funding.

claim: Rajasthan government halted student buses from Kota until UP paid Rs 19 lakh fuel dues
fact_check_summary: False. Cheque was dated after the last buses had already left. Timing did not match.

claim: Power supply discrimination (electricity during Ramzan but not Diwali)
fact_check_summary: Contradicted by official power supply data showing higher or comparable supply during Diwali period.
source_type: Fact-check by The Wire using official statistics

claim: Modi stopped the Russia-Ukraine war (‘War rukwa di’)
fact_check_summary: Misleading exaggeration. India conducted evacuations and pursued strategic autonomy, but the war continued. MEA clarified the claim overstated India’s role.
source_type: Fact-check by The Quint and MEA statements

claim: Manmohan Singh said Muslims have the first right over India’s resources
fact_check_summary: Out of context. Full 2009 statement referred to SCs, STs, OBCs and minorities (particularly Muslims) having first claim on resources for development plans.
source_type: Fact-check by The Quint, Alt News, archived PMO text

claim: Protesters raised ‘Pakistan Zindabad’ slogans in Lucknow anti-CAA rally
fact_check_summary: False. Audio analysis showed protesters saying ‘Kashif saab zindabad’, not Pakistan Zindabad.

claim: Shaheen Bagh protesters were paid and given biryani
fact_check_summary: Baseless. Collaborative investigation by Alt News and Newslaundry found no evidence supporting the claim.

claim: Ayushman Bharat covered 50 crore Indians (early claims)
fact_check_summary: Inflated at the time. Early official data showed far fewer actual treatments and cards issued than claimed.
